en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a European town with many detached houses and gardens, a meandering road with stone walls, and a small manor-like building with a turret in the foreground. In the distance stands a tall church with a slender spire dominating the skyline, and beyond that a river or broad waterway and low hills. The architecture looks Central European, with steep tiled roofs and masonry houses. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
